title: Dimension of the commutant: dim_K C(M) = n for nonderogatory M

problemStatement.formal: For a field K and M in K^{n×n}, with centralizer C(M) = {A : AM = MA}: M nonderogatory (μ_M = χ_M) ⟺ dim_K C(M) = n ⟺ C(M) = K[M]. In general dim_K C(M) = ∑_{i,j} min(d_i, d_j) = ∑_i (2i−1) d_i, where d_1 ∣ ⋯ ∣ d_k are the degrees of the invariant factors of M (Frobenius).
problemStatement.plain: The commutant C(M) is the set of matrices commuting with M; it always contains the polynomial algebra K[M]. When M is nonderogatory (minimal polynomial equals characteristic polynomial, equivalently M has a cyclic vector), C(M) equals K[M] and has dimension exactly n. This problem formalizes that dimension count and the general Frobenius formula dim_K C(M) = ∑_i (2i−1) d_i measuring the larger commutant of a derogatory matrix in terms of its invariant-factor degrees.
whyMatters: Completes the standard triple characterization of nonderogatory matrices with a quantitative invariant, dim_K C(M) = n, building on the gallery entry that proved only the set-level inclusion C(M) = K[M].

The Frobenius commutant-dimension formula is foundational for matrix similarity, modules over a PID, and applications in representation theory and control theory; a machine-checked version would bridge rational canonical form and explicit centralizer computations.

proven: commuting_matrix_is_polynomial: for cyclic M, C(M) = K[M] as sets, over arbitrary fields (parent entry, 0 sorries, 0 axioms).
Nonderogatory ⟺ cyclic vector, over arbitrary fields (ancestor entries).

Classically (Hoffman–Kunze §7.5; Gantmacher Ch. VIII): dim_K C(M) = n ⟺ M nonderogatory, and the Frobenius formula dim_K C(M) = ∑_i (2i−1) d_i.
open: No Lean formalization of the dimension statement dim_K C(M) = n for nonderogatory M (only the set equality C(M) = K[M] is in the gallery).
The general Frobenius formula dim_K C(M) = ∑_{i,j} min(d_i, d_j) for derogatory M is not formalized.
The converse edge C(M) = K[M] ⟹ M has a cyclic vector ((iii)⟹(ii)) is not yet in the gallery.
knownResults.goal: Formalize dim_K C(M) = n for nonderogatory M (from the existing C(M) = K[M] plus dim_K K[M] = deg μ_M = n), then the biconditional dim_K C(M) = n ⟺ M nonderogatory, with the Frobenius formula dim_K C(M) = ∑_i (2i−1) d_i as a stretch goal via rational canonical form.
